name: Tiktaalik
provenance: Late Devonian, early Frasnian Fram Formation, Ellesmere Island, Nunavut, Canada
description: Broad-headed finned tetrapodomorph with dorsal eyes, a mobile neck, rib-supported low trunk and robust jointed paired fins retaining fin-ray webs.

sources.title: Daeschler, Shubin & Jenkins 2006, Devonian tetrapod-like fish
Shubin, Daeschler & Jenkins 2006, Tiktaalik pectoral fin
Stewart et al. 2020, fin ray patterns

notes: Original Tiktaalik roseae reconstruction of a representative 2 m animal, not a fossil scan or species maximum.
Broad flattened skull with posterior dorsal orbits, short mobile neck and no bony opercular cover; the rigid central skull is not stretched during cheek expansion.

Four robust fins retain continuous lepidotrichial webs; the pectoral skeleton has shoulder, elbow and distal support zones, not tetrapod fingers. Pelvic fins are substantial but restricted hip retraction does not imply normal terrestrial walking.
Rhombic narrowly overlapping scales and dermal roof texture are fossil-informed. Pigmentation, soft tissues and the low inferred caudal outline remain artistic reconstruction.

Animations represent aquatic undulation, paddling, bracing, neck aiming, gape and modest cheek expansion. Growth is a relaxed extension display, with no body scaling. Runtime labels do not define Devonian gameplay.
